It’s hard to keep up with the fascism that is unfolding as the Trump MAGA
regime and party bid to consolidate a new form of governance atop the United
States. Here, below, are some important recent developments from the Trump47
campaign to makeover US government and society on fascist lines.

**Threatening Epic War Crimes Against Humanity**

In an interview with Fatherland (FOX) News earlier this week, the fascist US
president threatened to bomb all of Iran’s bridges and power plants,
explicitly adding that the nation’s entire population of 91 million might soon
be without electricity. This Hitlerian threat of collective punishment –
illegal under the Geneva Conventions – raises the specter of sheer
humanitarian catastrophe on a monumental scale. The fact that Trump could make
such a sociopathic threat is symptomatic of his and his regime’s
eliminationist/genocidal mindset.

**Fake Threat: Rubio’s Claim that Cuba is Directing a Wave of Radical Left
Terrorism in the US**

Last week the fascist US Secretary of State Marco Rubio released a bizarre
100-page report entitled _Cuba: The Capital of 21st Century Communism_. This
paranoid-style neo-McCarthyite document names more than 40 liberal and leftish
politicians, influencers and groups as tools of Cuba’s alleged “sustained
campaign of subversion” against the US. Presenting no serious evidence for its
truly wild claims that Cuba has conducted “a campaign that has _infiltrated
the highest reaches of the US government_ [!], recruited and cultivated
generations of American activists, backed _an unprecedented wave of leftwing
terrorism on American soil_ [!], and carried out _one of the most durable and
damaging foreign intelligence penetrations in American history_ [!]” (emphasis
and exclamations added), Rubio’s report contains a not-so fearsome roster of
US “radical leftists” including New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani, streamer
Hasan Piker, Ben and Jerry’s founder Ben Cohen, Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass,
the Amazon Labor Union leader Chris Small, Black Lives Matter co-founder
Alicia Garza, US Representative Maxine Waters (D-CA), and US Representative
Ilhan Omar (D-MN).

Rubio’s deranged document absurdly claims that the mildly social democratish
Democratic Socialists of America “serve as a particularly potent illustration
of the ideological victory of Cuba’s effort to position itself as the
spiritual capital of Third-Worldist radicalism.” The unhinged report
shamelessly invokes the supposed positive legacy of “the blacklists, McCarthy-
era investigations and prosecutions” as instruments of the post-WWII Red
Scare’s “effectiveness at dismembering the Communist Party USA.”

**“The Very Survival of Humanity”**

Mein Trumpf’s top political and policy adviser, the open fascist Stephen “We
are the Storm” Miller took RepubliNazi redbaiting to new levels this week. He
said this about the 2026 midterms elections:

“ _The very survival of freedom, liberty, humanity, your family, your children
and your future depends on ensuring that we do not allow communism to take
hold. AOC, Bernie, Omar—these are people who, even 10-15 years ago, would have
been relegated to the outermost fringes. They are now the heart of the party.
The Democrats have become the party of freaks, weirdos, losers, and crazies_.”

The notion that “communism” has taken hold of the Democratic Party is of
course pure fascist fiction. This wild claim is being rolled out again nearly
eight decades after the Cold War Red Scare as part of the Trump regime’s
determination to cancel the midterms or refuse to honor their outcomes this
coming fall and winter. (The “progressive” Dems AOC, Bernie, and Mamdani are
mild social democrats at leftmost, hardly sympathetic to the communist
revolution[s] that humanity requires if it not going to experience societal
collapse [at best] and extinction [at worst] thanks to the accelerating
depredations of the world capitalist-imperial system.)

**“No Choice But to Seize Voting Machines”**

The liberal voting rights expert [Ari Berman recently and rightly said this
](https://newrepublic.com/article/213480/transcript-angry-trump-urges-gop-rig-
midterms-polls-turn-brutal)to _The New Republic’s_ Greg Sargent about Trump’s
continuing mad effort to make the US Senate pass the vote-suppressing “SAVE
America Act” and about Trump’s recent wild speech falsely claiming that
American elections are insecure from foreign (principally Chinese)
interference:

“He’s using the SAVE America Act as a pretext to challenge the legitimacy of
the midterms. So if it does not pass, which it won’t pass, he’s going to say,
we don’t have the SAVE America Act, therefore the elections were rigged,
therefore I have no choice but to challenge the legitimacy of the midterms.
And he’s going to point to that crazy speech he gave and say, I laid out all
the evidence—even though he laid out no evidence, but he’s going to say, I
laid out all the evidence, the elections were rigged, the Congress didn’t act
on this, therefore I have no choice but to issue a national emergency
executive order, or seize voting machines, or take some kind of dramatic
intervention to mess with the midterms” (emphasis added).

**Warning Against History**

One week ago, Mein Trumpf ordered that “warning” signs be placed in front of
the Smithsonian’s National Museum of American History to inform visitors of
the “inaccurate information presented in the Museum.” The fascist Dear Leader
(well, Stephen Miller) wrote that the museum “does not present American
history as a shared national inheritance to be taught and celebrated, but
instead views American history as a ‘prime tool’ to advance ideas of social
justice and the radical transformation of our society.”

This is Trump’s way of seeking to render illegitimate the accurate portrayal
of the disastrous genocidal racism, ethnic cleansing, slavery, imperialism,
class exploitation, environmental ruin, and patriarchy that have marked the US
American historical experience. The core fascist characteristic of
“palingenetic ultra-nationalism” -- the ideal of resurrecting a glorious but
liberal- and left-betrayed national greatness -- requires whitewashing the
terrible history that Trump-fascism represents in contemporary form. Along
with the deletion of past and ongoing crimes, MAGA history demands omission of
the great people’s struggles that oppression has sparked past and present.

**Real Threat:_Agents of Chaos and Cruelty_**

Moving from fascist fantasies positing fake threats to actual, reality-based
threats to freedom and security inside the US, a new ACLU report reveals the
scale of civil rights violations committed by ICE and the police forces it has
deputized. The report, titled “[ _Agents of Chaos and
Cruelty_](https://www.aclu.org/publications/agents-of-chaos-and-cruelty-how-
the-trump-administrations-national-deportation-policing-force-has-attacked-
american-communities) _,_ ” reviewed and documented more than 1,200 incidents
in eight states in 2025. It found that ICE and agents working for ICE — what
the ACLU calls the “national deportation policing force”(NDPF) – have
undertaken methods and routine tactics that “lead to serious civil rights
violations. [ICE is] committing these violations at a scale and severity
without precedent in our nation’s recent history.” In a subsection of the
report titled “Turning American Streets Into Deportation Zones,” the ACLU
notes that ICE’s methods and tactics are:

“ _straight from the authoritarian playbook_. The Trump administration deploys
anti-immigrant scapegoating and _nearly explicit white supremacist narratives,
even featuring white supremacist slogans and images in its recruitment
campaigns_. Its deportation drive also involves suppressing dissent, evading
checks and balances, and consolidating executive power” (emphasis added).

Further:

“In 2025, senior [Trump] officials [above all the open fascist Stephen “We are
the Storm” Miller] created a _national deportation policing force of officers
who appeared masked and menacing in our communities. They treated it as the
president’s personal force to be deployed against American cities perceived as
hostile to his interests, during political standoffs with the opposing party,
and in response to protests._ _Now, the national deportation policing force is
— with little public notice — operating all over the country, with state and
local police conducting traffic stops and setting up checkpoints for
immigration enforcement. ..What we are experiencing mirrors aspects of
countries under authoritarian rule, where the loss of basic freedoms grows so
widespread that it seems less remarkable over time and simply becomes a fact
of life. We must prevent the abuses we’ve seen across the country from
becoming an accepted, new norma.”_

(It’s too much to expect the ACLU to call the Trump regime fascist, and not
merely authoritarian, I suppose)

_Agents of Chaos and Cruelty_ reflects on how the regime’s assault on
immigrant and other Americans has expanded in new form since ICE’s (actually
Border Patrol’s) murder of citizen protesters Renee Good and Alex Pretti in

“The Trump administration [regime] is _ramping up immigration arrests and
deportations to_[ _record-
breaking_](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/01/us/politics/ice-immigrant-
arrests-surge.html) _levels_. _Instead of surging into one city at a time — as
we saw in Minneapolis and Los Angeles, for instance — the administration is
escalating its deportation efforts in communities across the country, at the
same time._ A larger-than-ever ICE, together with the thousands of state and
local police they have deputized, is attempting to arrest scores of people on
American streets in the coming weeks to meet a quota. These street arrests,
which ICE has never previously conducted at this scale, will endanger
everyone’s rights and safety.”

(New court filings this week show that ICE and Border Patrol agents who swept

American rhetoric.” BN is being investigated for committing the crime of

targeted federal immigration enforcement actions. Aid networks ramped up their
work to help immigrants too fearful to leave their homes. Hotlines rang out
with calls from panicked immigrants. And routine traffic stops led to
immigration arrests.”

Trump says he has “plans for similar task forces elsewhere, particularly in

(Earlier this month, Herr Trump and Herr Miller’s “Memphis Safe Task Force”
